Thanks to [@Inch-high](https://github.com/Inch-high) for reporting the **Test host visibility** error on [#12](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/12).

### What changed

* **`ui/templates/settings.html`** — **Test host visibility** now sends `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (fixes HTTP 415)

### Install / Upgrade

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

On Unraid: **Force Update** **AMUD-Dashboard** (agent unchanged for this fix), then hard-refresh Settings.
